name: Pink House R
source: you take the role of a man who has lost everything, his job because of a cheating by his bosses, his wife leaves him when he loses his job and can't give her the life she is used to. but all is not lost, your brother invites you to spend some time with him, but you have other plans.
translation: 你扮演一个男人，他因为老板的欺骗而失去了一切，失去了工作，当他失去工作并且无法给她习惯的生活时，他的妻子离开了他。但一切还没有结束，你的兄弟邀请你和他一起度过一段时间，但你有其他计划。
